purpose: Stopped held-out attempt for the validation-selected stride-24 MambaTSv3 relation-auxiliary candidate; superseded before completion by a CPU-thread-limited retraining plan.
research_question: Does a full-coverage stride-24 AutoCon MambaTSv3 retain non-inferiority to strong forecasting and Mamba baselines on untouched Electricity/Traffic H96 test windows while preserving its validation-supported fixed-shape efficiency boundary?
evidence_boundary: This attempt is incomplete because CPU thread limits were changed after launch. Its partial selection/candidate/baseline artifacts are retained for operational audit only and cannot enter held-out analysis.
claim_boundary: If approved and passed, this release supports only Electricity/Traffic H96 comparisons for the registered stride-24 configuration. It cannot establish universal accuracy, causal AutoCon attribution, or universal speed superiority.

required_before_launch: verify Electricity and Traffic fingerprints and exact 86-job expansion
confirm the stride-24 relation-auxiliary candidate, its AutoCon participation audit, and seven comparator configurations are frozen from validation
verify current default Mamba-1 stride-24 path remains semantically equivalent to the frozen validation snapshot
approve the exact plan SHA-256 in a separate launch sidecar
run all phases from one immutable source snapshot and read test metrics only after strict validation

selection_contract.freeze_rule: Stride-24 candidate, baselines, data split, optimizer, scheduler, budget, normalization, horizon and confirmation seeds are frozen before test execution; no held-out signal may select a model or setting.

capacity_fairness_contract.common_public_budget: All arms share chronological split, M features, sequence length, horizon, optimizer, scheduler, batch size, epochs, patience and normalization.
capacity_fairness_contract.candidate_boundary: Only MambaTSv3AutoCon receives the frozen AutoCon objective with lambda=.001; its full-coverage patch_len=patch_stride=24 configuration has prediction-connected representation fusion disabled. The six validation candidates have a separate finite-loss/effective-lambda training audit.
capacity_fairness_contract.baseline_boundary: DLinear, NLinear, RLinear, PatchTST, TimesNet, iTransformer and Mamba2 receive no AutoCon, representation-fusion, ACF-memory or candidate-only settings.
capacity_fairness_contract.test_read_gate: Read test metrics only after every registered phase validator succeeds.

phases.name: selection_stride24_relation_auxiliary_validation
phases.purpose: Validation reproducibility check for the frozen stride-24 relation-auxiliary candidate; test split remains disabled.

phases.name: confirmatory_stride24_relation_auxiliary_candidate_test
phases.purpose: Frozen stride-24 relation-auxiliary MambaTSv3 candidate held-out Electricity/Traffic H96 phase.

phases.name: confirmatory_stride24_strong_baselines_test
phases.purpose: Frozen same-source DLinear, NLinear, RLinear, PatchTST, TimesNet, iTransformer and Mamba2 held-out comparators.

comparison_contract.reporting_rule: Report paired seed-level mean MSE, wins, one-sided upper ratio and all failure cells; forecast windows and channels are not independent replicates.

statistical_gate.interpretation: A cell is non-inferior only if its one-sided paired upper MSE ratio is <=1.02. Five confirmation seeds are the uncertainty unit.

resource_contract.efficiency_claim_gate: Report prediction-only speed only for named comparators whose registered accuracy gate passes; never use training wall time as inference throughput.
